intent: Relax an over-tight researcher-entry gate without weakening truth ownership. Extend CAP-0005 so a subject can enter the historical researcher universe either through direct source-grounded industry membership or through a deterministic, auditable entailment from already-grounded Reality/Judgment carrying explicit industry scope. Keep the two provenance classes distinct. Entailed discoverability must not create membership, value-chain role, importance, causality, controversy or historical timing. Reuse the same subject-universe logic in orientation and historical open-state views.
rationale: The prior CAP-0005 composition required a visible core.industry_entity_memberships row before an entity was even passed to the typed memory snapshot. That made a missing catalog projection suppress already-grounded Reality/Judgment/Outcome and historical controversy. The user correctly identified this as over-tight certainty. The repair belongs inside CAP-0005 researcher discovery, not in CAP-0003 truth semantics: direct membership remains strongest, while accepted Reality or grounded Judgment with explicit industry scope can mechanically entail researcher discoverability at the same no-lookahead cutoff. This broadens recall without promoting the entailment into a new truth record or semantic owner.
